newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN COACH URGES SMALL TO SORT OUT PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICAN COACH URGES SMALL TO SORT OUT PROBLEMS.

text.p: South Africa coach Andre Markgraaff urged winger James Small on Saturday to sort out his problems with his Springbok team mates in order to return to the national side.
According to newspaper reports, Small was not considered for the recent series against the New Zealand All Blacks because he had fallen out with his colleagues.
"He's a brilliant player," Markgraaff said in a television interview.
"I'd love to have him in the team. He must just sort out his problems with his fellow-players. If he can do that, we'll pick him."
